text: A party to plan. Hello, captain! I'm Grandma Zuzu. My grandson Bix turns ten tomorrow, and I'm throwing him the biggest party this side of the galaxy!
Oh dear, oh dear. But I have nothing ready! I need star-berries for the cake, sparkle candles that fizz, and a robot band that can really boogie.
Off you zoom. It's all paid for. Just fly to each planet and pick it up. I've marked them on your star map. Off you zoom, dear!
Party time! You did it! Look at Bix's face! The cake is purple, the candles are fizzing, and the robot band won't stop dancing.
Thank you, dear. Here's your reward, captain, and a slice of cake for the trip. You're welcome at my table any time!
